description: This file is a FastAPI application that defines REST API endpoints for a utility asset management backend. It includes routes for health checks, asset listing and retrieval, inspections, alerts, and work orders, utilizing a PostgreSQL database via fetch functions.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health_check()
methods.description: A health check endpoint returning a simple message indicating the service is operational.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_assets(limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500))
methods.description: Returns a list of assets from the database, limited by the 'limit' query parameter.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_asset(asset_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a single asset by its ID from the database, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_inspections(asset_id: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500))
methods.description: Lists inspections, optionally filtered by asset ID, sorted by inspection date.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_alerts( asset_id: Optional[str] = None, unacknowledged_only: bool = False, limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500), )
methods.description: Lists alerts, with optional filtering by asset ID and acknowledgment status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_work_orders( status: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500), )
methods.description: Lists work orders, optionally filtered by status.
